name: Chandra B.
text: Derek was amazing, professional and provided stellar service! I would highly recommend him for any duct work you need, you will not be disappointed. Quality service 10 of 10 for sure!

name: Sharon A.
text: It is always a great experience with Duct Hunt! We have used them exclusively for the last 4 years and Derek has also taken great care of the air ducts in our children's homes. Derek is honest, thorough, knowledgeable and has an excellent work ethic.

name: Andy X.
text: Derek was great to work with. He was able to get me on the schedule quickly and he was very informative about the process. He arrived at the time he specified, had all my vents cleaned and showed me before and after pictures of my vents.

name: Christina C.
text: Great experience from scheduling to completion. Derek communicated very well and kept me updated on arrival times. The cost was very reasonable, far less than the larger companies. Great experience with an honest and hardworking individual. Highly recommended.

name: Kirah H.
text: Great experience with Duct Hunt. Derek was extremely responsive, easy to work with and professional. Derek was able to get us on his schedule quickly and made it super easy. Would definitely recommend this business.

name: Kyle L.
text: Derek was on-time, friendly, professional, & efficient!! There were no surprise fees involved, the previously agreed upon price was what I paid! He was able to get all the air ducts/returns in our 3,000 sq ft home cleaned in under 2 hours!

name: Mike R.
text: Derek was polite, efficient and transparent. He talked us through the process and showed us before/after pictures of the ducts. Great service!

name: Amanda T.
text: Our home was built in '79 and has NEVER been cleaned! So glad all this dirt is gone! Derek was professional, great small talk, good guy! Best of all, it's AFFORDABLE!

name: Dori L.
text: This was my first experience with an air duct cleaning company and it went very smoothly from start to finish. Derek did a fantastic job, showed up on time, and explained the process as he did it.

name: Rachel B.
text: Derek is great! Communicates well and prompt. Highly recommend! I recommend him to my real estate clients, friends, and family!

name: Cathy J.
text: Derek was so quick to answer my phone call and let me know how much it would run and when he had available. He texted me the night before letting me know when he would be there. His price was very reasonable and he did a fantastic job cleaning all of the ducts and the dryer vent.

name: Molly B.
text: Derek was super helpful in helping us understand our system and came by the very next day and took care of cleaning our dryer vent and dryer duct all together for a flat fee. He was very professional and kind!

name: L.H.
text: Not only did Derek come on time and do a fantastic job, but he is also the owner! Now even the air smells different. Now we can really breathe! Thanks Derek!

name: Adrie O.
text: Derek the owner is super responsive, gave me a quote in a timely fashion. Got my vents/ducts and dryer vent cleaned and he was professional and took before and after pictures. He did a great job and will use again.

name: Ron S.
text: Great experience! On time and friendly. We can already tell a difference with our dust factor and furnace does not seem to be working as hard. I was given some good advice about filters. He cleaned up thoroughly. Good price. Highly recommend.

name: Austin H.
text: Derek was great to work with, he was very responsive and accommodating with our schedule. Would definitely recommend!

name: Kristina J.
text: I would 100% recommend Duct Hunt to anyone! Derek was professional, kind, respectful, clean, and awesome! He explained what he was going to do, answered my many questions, and was very thorough, not only in his work, but cleaning up afterwards!

name: Donna M.
text: Derek was punctual and very nice. He did an outstanding job and was very thorough. He left our house just like he found it, except awesomely clean ducts.

name: Brock F.
text: Derek was unbelievably professional. We needed the air ducts cleaned in an emergency before our firstborn came home that evening. He arranged to come first thing that morning. He is also very personable and will walk you through his process. You saved the day.

name: Elena G.
text: Highly recommend this local small business owner! Returned my call within 15 min & scheduled at my convenience. Great service & very reasonable cost. Very much appreciated his explanation of the process & tips to maintain upkeep.

name: Brock B.
text: Next day service! It was very quick, very professional. Seeing how much nasty stuff was in the vent was very surprising. Dryer works like a champ now. 10/10 will be using Duct Hunt again.

name: Joanna L.
text: Derek was very professional and friendly. He sent me a reminder the day before our appointment. He was on time, knowledgeable, and kind. I 100% recommend Duct Hunt.

name: Veronica B.
text: We use this guy on our house and he was very professional and honest. I've also referred him to many of my clients. This guy is a 10 out of 10.

name: Tracy P.
text: Derek did a great job, and was very friendly and thorough! I can definitely tell a difference in the air quality, and will be recommending to friends and family!

name: Saria A.
text: Derek was courteous, professional, and thorough! Within hours of cleaning my vents, I noticed my allergy symptoms are significantly improved.

name: Nick A.
text: We could tell the difference immediately. Dusting every day was wearing on us. With the new baby it's nice to know she won't be breathing that stuff. THANK YOU!

name: Marilyn V.
text: Thank you Derek for a job well done... very professional, hard working... would recommend everyone to give Derek a call. You will not be disappointed.

name: Melissa K.
text: Highly recommend! Did a great job, super nice, left everything clean, got us in quick, very up front and honest.

name: Brett G.
text: Did a great job. Fast and efficient cleaning. Would recommend this company and service to anyone looking for a duct cleaning.

name: Russ S.
text: Great job. Professional and complete. Very satisfied with the work and at a good price. Thanks!
